observations.description: Byte-stable round trips for empty and populated ledgers. save/load/save stable. Decimal, UTC timestamp, and enum type preservation verified.

Whitelisted immutable types only. _encode rejects floats and unknown types. _decode rejects floats, lists, unknown dataclasses, unknown enums, excessive nesting (>64), non-finite Decimals, naive/non-UTC timestamps.
Duplicate JSON keys reject at every object level via object_pairs_hook=_no_duplicates.
Missing/extra/malformed/oversized/non-UTF8/wrong-schema checkpoints all reject. Empty, non-UTF-8, oversized (>64MB) all reject.
Payload SHA-256 detects every single-field mutation. Authority tamper (advisory_only/live_trading_permitted/trading_authority) rejects even with recomputed checksum.
Restored PaperPerformanceLedgerV1 and InstrumentAccountingLedgerV2 identities, snapshots, source events, and fingerprints revalidated. Tampered accounting events reject.

Atomic initialization and replacement via O_EXCL lock + temp + os.replace + fsync. Existing checkpoint cannot be overwritten by initialize. Single-writer lock contention rejects. Stale CAS rejects without changing retained checkpoint. Locks and temp files cleaned after success and controlled failures. Missing parent rejects. Missing checkpoint load rejects.
Symlinked checkpoint and lock paths reject as unsafe.

No pickle, eval, exec, dynamic import, arbitrary class loading, outbound network, or credentials. Only whitelisted dataclasses and enums. Only hashlib, json, os, pathlib, uuid, datetime, decimal, enum, dataclasses, accounting, ohlc_execution, specifications, paper_performance_ledger imported.
advisory_only=True, live_trading_permitted=False, trading_authority=False hardcoded in checkpoint payload and verified at load time.

accepted_after_correction: _canonical returns bytes not str — removed .encode() from all checksum recompute calls
test_float_rejects (corrected: float injection into $decimal doesn't reject because Decimal(10000.0) is valid; changed to test _encode guard for raw floats)
redundant: Some adversarial tests overlap with existing on round trip, checksum tamper, authority tamper, malformed checkpoint, atomic store, existing checkpoint, symlink
implementation_coupled: _canonical is imported from the module for checksum recompute attacks — this is necessary to test the security boundary but is a direct dependency on an internal function
